thread:
alex: 🚨 quick post about the weekend — we got a big fallthrough from our promo traffic into eu-west-1 which triggered sustained GPU queueing and soft throttles. can we capture the numbers and root cause here?
mira: saw it in the dashboards, GPU queuing spiked around 02:14->08:45 UTC. latency p50 jumped, and some requests hit the fallback path.
tony: short version: forecasting underestimated promo uplift (model predicted ~220 rps, actual ~760 rps for the promo cohort) and our regional buffer wasn't applied because the event flag wasn't surfaced to the scaler.
jen: quantified it: additional ~560 GPU-hours consumed in EUW1 over ~6.5h window. cost delta estimate ~ $4.2k (ballpark).
alex: can you paste the queries you used? want to include in the retro doc.
mira: prometheus query I used — gpu memory + queue depth by cluster: ```sum by(cluster) (gpu_memory_used_bytes) / sum by(cluster) (gpu_memory_total_bytes)```
Also queueing: ```sum by(cluster) (inflight_requests)```
tonny: (typo) tony: also pulled the autoscaler logs — we rejected scaling beyond 1.2x min because the policy relied on the `event_id` tag that our promo router didn't attach for legacy partners.
sre-bot: incident-note: autoscaler prevented scale-up 02:18:03-02:41:12 UTC due to missing tag filter match.
jen: impact summary: short tail of increased latency for ~7% of promo users, no hard OOMs, no data loss. we did see soft throttles / 429s on retry-unfriendly clients.
sam: root cause hypothesis: 3 problems aligned — (1) forecasting model blind to partner promo -> underpredict, (2) scaler policy depends on a tag that wasn't populated, (3) regional safety buffer was set to 4% which is too low for promotional bursts.
alex: lessons & mitigations proposed: 1) fix ingestion so `event_id` flows into scaler metrics by EOD, 2) bump eu-west-1 regional buffer to 12% for promos and add a dynamic promo multiplier, 3) add a short-term rule to increase autoscale max growth to 2.5x for tagged promos, 4) add an alert for sustained queueing > 3m.
mira: additional ask: improve demand forecast window — include promo event calendar as an external feature. model retrain + hinge features scheduled for next cycle.
tony: quick ops changes we applied during the event: bumped euw1 min GPUs from 10 -> 14, borrowed 4 GPUs from staging (pre-emptible), and flipped temporary fallback off for low-priority routes. that shaved peak latency by ~18%.
jen: retrospective numbers to include: predicted GPU-hours for weekend promo: 160; actual used: 720; delta +560 -> 3.5x error.
sam: long-term changes to prevent recurrence: (A) surface promo calendar into forecasting, (B) add 'promo' flag end-to-end, (C) change scaler policy to use aggregate demand metric as fallback if tag missing, (D) increase cost alert sensitivity so we detect $2k+ overnight anomalies.
alex: immediate owners: Mira (telemetry fix for event tag), Tony (autoscaler fallback change), Jen (retro doc + cost calc), Sam (forecast model features). please ack.
mira: ack. I'll open the telemetry PR and link here.
tony: ack, will draft scaler fallback plan.
sam: ack, starting a forecast-tuning ticket and posterity eval.
jen: ack, will write short retro and cost appendix — will ping finance for exact billing numbers.
alex: thanks all. I'll compile the thread into the incidents folder draft. we'll review in ops sync tomorrow. :thumbsup:
